It then introduces an optimization formulation L(V) defined in Equation 11 as the sum of L̃_proj (robust projection data term), R_smooth (smoothness regularization), and R_orientation (orientation regularization). The text confirms these terms are differentiable and designed to optimize vertex locations jointly, thereby supporting every fact in the claim.
